360° Virtual Tours for Wedding Halls and Event Venues in Bangalore

Couples, families abroad and event planners all want to see the hall before they book. A 360° tour shows the stage, dining area and guest capacity in one link.

By Thamco360 · 15 September 2026 · 3 min read

Key takeaways

  • Families shortlist venues together — often across cities and countries.
  • A tour shows stage, seating, dining and rooms in context.
  • Planners can present your venue to clients without a visit.
  • Capture can be done empty, decorated, or both.

In this guide

  1. How venues are chosen
  2. What a venue tour should show
  3. Empty or decorated?
  4. Where couples and planners find it
  5. Frequently asked questions

How venues are chosen

A wedding or large event in Bangalore usually involves many decision-makers: the couple, both families, relatives abroad and often an event planner. Everyone wants to see the venue, but getting them all there on the same day is hard, and dates in the season fill fast.

A 360° tour of your kalyana mantapa, banquet hall, convention centre or farmhouse venue lets everyone walk the space from their own phone and agree on a shortlist quickly.

What a venue tour should show

  • The main hall from the entrance, the stage and the centre, so capacity is obvious.
  • Stage and mandap area.
  • Dining hall and buffet layout.
  • Bride and groom rooms and guest rooms if available.
  • Lawns and open-air areas for mehendi, sangeet or receptions.
  • Entrance, lifts and parking — critical for elderly guests.

Empty or decorated?

An empty hall shows the true space and lets clients imagine their own theme. A decorated hall shows what is possible. Many venues capture the empty hall once and add a decorated capture during an event setup, with the organiser’s permission and before guests arrive.

Where couples and planners find it

Publish the tour to your Google Business Profile so it appears when people search for wedding halls or banquet halls near them, embed it on your website’s venue page, and share the link with planners. Frequently asked questions

Should a wedding venue be shot empty or decorated?

Both work. An empty hall shows the true space and capacity, while a decorated capture shows what is possible. Many venues do an empty capture first and add a decorated one during an event setup, with permission and before guests arrive.

Can you capture multiple halls at one venue?

Yes. Each hall, lawn and dining area is captured as part of one connected tour so clients can move between them.

How long does a venue shoot take?

A single hall with dining and rooms is usually captured in a few hours. Convention centres with multiple halls and lawns take longer and are planned around your bookings.

Will the tour help families abroad choose our venue?

Yes. Relatives abroad can walk through the venue from their phones and join the decision without travelling.

What does a wedding venue virtual tour cost?

Basic Thamco360 packages start from just ₹7,999, and the final price depends on the number of halls and outdoor areas covered.
